decisions.reason: It has a dedicated market presence and fits the firm's core strength in reliable market data and precise calculation services for energy-sector sales support.
A location-based gas tariff comparison is close to the existing offer, clearly relevant for utility customers, and was promoted as a standalone product.
A regional electricity tariff calculator complements the firm's tariff and billing portfolio and supports the platform expansion strategy, with enough visibility to justify continuation.

Because it was only briefly mentioned and overlaps with the more specific gas and electricity calculator products, management would likely concentrate resources on the clearer, better-positioned tools.
The regional area definition tool appears to be an enabling product for location-based tariff and margin workflows and strengthens the firm's integrated platform approach.
This comparison product was only mentioned on the website and seems largely redundant with the stronger tariff comparison and calculator offerings already in the portfolio.
